text:
Zoe (support): Hey team — customer Olivia hit a 413 when calling /v1/rerank. Customer says they send a long query + ~120 docs. Error text is just `Request payload too large` and they can't figure what's over the limit. Can eng help clarify what we should tell them?

Olivia (customer): repro payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "query": "<~2.4k chars>",
  "docs": [ { "id": "d1", "text": "<~1.2k chars>" }, ... total 120 docs ]
}
```
They got HTTP 413, no token counts. Also they said they saw a billing charge for the failed call — they expect failed requests not to be billed.

Manny (eng-support): Thanks — can you paste the exact response body and request_id if available? Also which model they were reranking against? We need request_id to check logs.

Olivia (customer): Response body: `{"error":"Request payload too large"}`. Request id: `req_01GX0...` Model: `open-v1-rerank-small` (customer mentioned it's one of our smaller rerank models).

deploy-bot: New logs for req_01GX0... uploaded to ops-s3 (link)

Kai (eng-runtime): Quick diagnosis: rerank enforces a *combined token ceiling* computed from tokenized(query) + sum(tokenized(each doc.text)). The 413 currently returns a generic message. From logs I see combined token count ~= 6200 for that request; limit for `open-v1-rerank-small` is 4096. That matches 413.

Kai (eng-runtime): Two immediate asks: (1) Support should tell the customer how to measure tokens locally (we have a tokenizer library link) and recommend chunking or snippet-extraction strategies. (2) We should update the 413 response to include helpful fields: `combined_tokens`, `limit_tokens`, and optionally `sample_doc_indices` so the user knows which docs pushed them over. Example idea: `{"error":"payload too large","combined_tokens":6200,"limit":4096,"offending_docs":[5,6,7]}`.

Zoe (support): That would help a lot. Olivia — do you want a quick patch suggestion to chunk docs client-side?

Olivia (customer): Yes please, anything to get them unblocked. Also please confirm if that failed request will be refunded.

Manny (eng-support): On billing: our policy is to not charge for requests that fail pre-authorization or validation. 413 is a rejection at the router layer; I'll open a billing ticket and validate whether a credit is needed. Need timeline to respond to the customer (SLA).

Kai (eng-runtime): Quick client-side snippet we can share (psuedo):
```python
# naive chunk-by-token for rerank
from redwood_tokenizer import tokenize
MAX = 4096
q_tokens = len(tokenize(query))
kept = []
for i, doc in enumerate(docs):
    d_tokens = len(tokenize(doc['text']))
    if q_tokens + sum(len(tokenize(d['text'])) for d in kept) + d_tokens <= MAX:
        kept.append(doc)
    else:
        # if doc itself > small threshold, take a snippet
        snippet = doc['text'][:1000]
        kept.append({'id': doc['id'], 'text': snippet})
# then call /v1/rerank with kept
```
Small note: tokenizers are faster if you cache doc token counts ahead of time.

Kai (eng-runtime): For server-side UX: propose we change 413 body to include token counts and the model tier limit, and include KB link: https://redwood.ai/docs/rerank-limits (KB draft). This will cut down support back-and-forth.

Zoe (support): +1 — can eng drop a short PR for the error payload change? We can then update KB and send Olivia the new message format so they can self-triage.

Kai (eng-runtime): I'll open a tiny change: expose three fields on validation error: `combined_tokens`, `limit_tokens`, `top_offenders` (doc indices). Will include a non-sensitive sample in the body. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

Manny (eng-support): I'll own the billing check; Zoe, please ask Olivia for any invoice ids. Zoe, please also offer the client-side snippet above as an immediate workaround.

Olivia (customer): Thanks — invoice id `inv_2023_09_18_42`. We'll try the suggested chunking tonight. Appreciate the quick answers. :raised_hands:

Zoe (support): Sending the snippet + link to KB draft. Will follow up after billing confirms. :thumbsup:

Kai (eng-runtime): Follow-up note for product: consider lowering default error message TTL in SDKs so users see explanation in-place. Also consider a client-side SDK helper `rerank.chunk_docs(docs, query, model_limit=4096)` to reduce churn.

Manny (eng-support): Filed billing ticket BT-9812, assigned to finance. Will update once credit decision is made.

Zoe (support): Closing loop here — Olivia, let us know if you still see 413 after chunking. I'll re-open if needed.
